text: Blockchains cannot access off-chain data, and resolving this by using centralized oracles nullifies the advantages of decentralized systems while creating major security risks such as bribing and intimidation.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Josh Bykowski, Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAO) – A Market Meta Analysis (2023). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4529715

isBasedOn.name: Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAO) – A Market Meta Analysis

abstract: There is something known as the oracle problem, which is the fact that blockchains themselves can't access off-chain data. Using centralized oracles nullifies the advantages of decentralized systems, and are major security risks (such as bribing, intimidation, etc.)
